articles.name: Shengqu apologizes, walks back gold-binding, ends Return Island Test early
articles.keywords: cms-cbt-cut-short-economy-walked-back Shengqu apologized and ended the first China Classic test early on May 31. It promised to restore regular gold in the auction house and remove equipment from the Mushroom Pass and Sky Pig Egg reward boxes. The auction house would accept regular gold alongside the special points system. Shengqu said it would keep fighting large bot farms through other rules. The early shutdown gave the team time to prepare the revised economy for the next test.  cot patch Shengqu

articles.name: Founder's Access Cash Shop prices: AP and SP Reset Scrolls cost 7,000 NX each
articles.keywords: founders-access-cash-shop-prices Nexon posted the Cash Shop list for Founder's Access, which opens October 6. AP Reset Scrolls and SP Reset Scrolls cost 7,000 NX each. Pets cost 3,500 NX and are permanent. The AP Reset Scroll resets all of your stats, including AP put into HP and MP. You must be level 10 to use it. The SP Reset Scroll resets every skill except Beginner skills. Neither scroll expires. The Convenience Essentials Pack costs 9,900 NX, once per account. It has one AP Reset Scroll, one SP Reset Scroll, a slot coupon, 10 Safety Charms, and 10 Super Megaphones. The six pets (Brown Kitty, Brown Puppy, Pink Bunny, Black Kitty, White Bunny, Black Pig) are permanent. Each needs a 2,000 NX Water of Life every 30 days. A Safety Charm costs 800 NX and a Megaphone costs 350 NX. A coupon for 5 more storage or inventory slots costs 5,000 NX. A Regular Store Permit costs 1,500 NX and lists 12 items. The Pink Store Permit costs 3,000 NX and lists 18. Both last 90 days. Mystery Hair Coupons cost 5,500 NX and give a random style. Signature Hair Coupons cost 7,500 NX and let you pick. Face coupons cost 3,500 and 5,500 NX. The pack is the cheapest way to get both reset scrolls: the two alone cost 14,000 NX. Its items cannot be traded. Gifting needs a level 12 character. patch Nexon

articles.name: Unscheduled COT maintenance ships hotfixes for crafting UI, mob stats, and quality-of-life
articles.keywords: unscheduled-maintenance-april-17 Nexon moved seven fixes forward to an April 17 maintenance from 5:00 to 7:00 AM Pacific. The update covered crafting, quest monsters, shops, spawns, gem processing, potion animations, and damage-number display. Crafting tools now open the crafting menu, and the Escape key closes Player Shops. Monsters in Kerning City Party Quest and second-job quests became easier to hit. Iron Hogs on Pig Beach received a new spawn rate. Arcforge gem-processing costs changed. HP and MP potions now play a character animation. Damage numbers remain visible when a monster overlaps the player.  cot patch maintenance Nexon
